features.title: Deterministic 1-bit / 1.58-bit Ternary Matrix Engine, FFN Squared ReLU Graph, and In-Memory Server
acceptance: Quantize continuous weights into ternary {-1, 0, +1} values with deterministic per-tensor scaling
Implement FFN activation forward graph comparing Squared ReLU and SiLU with perplexity metrics
Provide in-memory model execution and persistent chat completion API without reloading weights
Support token-based role authentication with secure local demo fallback

features.title: Compiler & Environment Matrix Diagnostic Suite
acceptance: Matrix scanner identifies compiler flags, Clang 20 const-pointer compatibility, and ARM vector type hazards
Diagnostic reporting exports environment verification recipes

features.title: AVX-512 & NEON 5-Activation Ternary Look-Up Table Kernel Profiler
acceptance: Benchmarks multi-activation LUT packing throughput against standard scalar ternary dot products
Generates hardware memory bandwidth and operational intensity comparison charts

features.title: Enhanced Evaluation CLI with LUT Kernel Benchmark Support and JSON Export
acceptance: CLI supports running LUT kernel benchmarks (scalar, 3-ary, 5-ary) via command line
CLI supports JSON output export for CI/CD integration
CLI includes all benchmark types in --benchmark all option

features.title: Multi-Provider Opt-In LLM Advisory Analysis & Evaluation CLI
acceptance: Deterministic evaluation CLI measures quantization perplexity across custom test corpora
Optional provider adapter formats evaluation reports using OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Ollama endpoints
